entries.author: CONSTANTINUS PORPHYROGENITUS
entries.title: De Cerimoniis Aulae Byzantinae libri duo, e recensione Joan. Jac. Reiskii, cum ejusdem Commentariis (collective title page)
entries.note: Elenchus prints this as a group head with col. 33, with Reiskii's Praefatio and Leichii listed beneath. Body: title page 'CONSTANTINI PORPHIROGENITI IMPERATORIS DE CEREMONIIS AULAE BYZANTINAE LIBRI DUO GRAECE ET LATINE...' at line 1155, page 33|34 (follows running head '31 ... 32' at line 1084). The two books themselves are entered separately below.

entries.author: CONSTANTINUS PORPHYROGENITUS
entries.title: B. G. Niebuhrii Praefatio (Ed. Bonn. 1829)
entries.note: NOT in the Elenchus; listed in the closing Ordo (col. 34, within +-1 of body page 33|34). Head at line 1164 directly under the collective title page. Mapping inferred from the Ordo.

entries.author: CONSTANTINUS PORPHYROGENITUS
entries.title: Joan. Jac. Reiskii Praefatio (Praefationes ad tomum primum)
entries.note: Elenchus OCR reads 33 (same as the title page above, likely a ditto or misprint); Ordo reads 35; body head 'JOAN. JAC. REISKII PRAEFATIONES / AD TOMUM PRIMUM' at lines 1224-1227, after the stray page number '36' at line 1221, so page 35|36. Believed 35 (body and Ordo agree).

entries.author: CONSTANTINUS PORPHYROGENITUS
entries.title: Joan. Henrici Leichii Commentatio de Vita et Rebus gestis Constantini Porphyrogeniti
entries.note: Head not found. OCR text skips from col 41|42 (running head '4i PRAEFATIONES', line 1621; Reiskii's Praefationes text ends mid-sentence at line ~1757) straight to page 49|50 (line 1759), where Leichii's preface is already running ('litteras meritis uberiorem materiam...', ends 'Vale, Lector', then CONSPECTUS at line 1780). pg-colfind shows the map jumping 39 to 49; pages 43-48 appear to be missing from the OCR. Ordo OCR reads '41' (garbled or wrong). Searched: COMMENTATIO|LEICH|LECHII|DE VITA ET REBUS, --heads 41-49, --col 45/47. Elenchus 45 is plausible but not confirmed in the body.

entries.author: CONSTANTINUS PORPHYROGENITUS
entries.title: Ex Adversariis Leichianis, de scriptis Constantini Porphyrogeniti (Excerptum)
entries.note: NOT in the Elenchus; listed in the closing Ordo (OCR '7A', i.e. 71). Head 'EX ADVERSARIIS LEICHIANIS / DE SCRIPTIS CONSTANTINI PORPHYROGENNETI' at line 2874 on the spread whose running head OCRs '74 EX ADVERSARIIS LEICHIANIS 19' (line 2861), page 71|72 by sequence (69|70 at line 2691, 73|74 at line 2982). A second head 'EX ISDEM ADVERSARIIS DE VITA CONSTANTINI...COLLECTANEA QUAEDAM' follows at line 2934; the title page of Liber I follows at line 2982.

SYNTAGMA' at line 3002, on the spread whose running head OCRs '73 DE CEREMONIIS AULAE BYZANTINAE LIB. I. 14' (line 2982), i.e. page 73|74; next spread header '75|76' at line 3110. Within +-1 of Ordo. entries.author: CONSTANTINUS PORPHYROGENITUS
entries.title: De iisdem Cerimoniis liber secundus

PORPHYROGENITI DE CERIMONIIS AULAE BYZANTINAE LIBER SECUNDUS' with Greek proemium (IIPOOIMION) at lines 77544-77597, on the spread before the '975 CONSTANTINI PORPHYROGENITI 976' header (line 77660), so page 973|974. Within +-1 of Ordo.
